messages:
julia-peopleops: Quick Q 1: I'm moving from NY -> CO and my last contractor invoice lands 4/15, start W2 4/16. Will that create any tax nexus issues for the company if I keep a NY billing address for invoices?

sam-payroll: Generally nexus is based on where you perform work from. If you plan to be physically in CO starting 4/16 then CO withholding applies from that date. For invoices before 4/16 with NY address it's fine, but Finance may flag GST/NY forms.

leo-eng: Also curious about WFH stipend. We get $80/mo in NY. Does that change when you move states?

julia-peopleops: Yep we have different stipend bands per state. Will I need to re-enroll or is it auto?

sam-payroll: Stipend: employees auto-enable stipend based on home state on payroll record. There is a manual override for special cases (eg split residency). Because your employment flips over mid-month, your 4/16 paycheck will show a pro-rated stipend for Apr. No need to re-enroll, but confirm new address in Rippling.

hr-bot: Reminder: update your home address via HR portal within 5 days of move or payroll withholding might be delayed. Link: https://intranet/hr/address-update

danielle: Also check your health benefits domicile rules. Some carriers vary by state. If you're moving to CO, you may have to select a different plan during enrollment window.

julia-peopleops: Thanks, I'll update Rippling today and cc payroll if anything weird shows up.
